It's a time for fitness, opportunities for youth, team bonding, squad building and tactical trials among other things. Match outcomes are largely meaningless, but can influence the narrative, tone and group morale heading into the new campaign.

This post summarizes pre-season schedules for each EPL team ahead of the 2026/2027 campaign that begins on August 21st 2026.
